verdict.rationale: Bevy documents hot reloading for scenes, textures, and meshes, with "instant feedback" and no restarts. For code changes, though, game logic is Rust, so it still needs a recompile; Bevy claims 0.8-3.0 seconds with its "fast compiles" configuration. That makes the loop near-instant for assets and only reasonably fast for logic. Missing for 10: true hot reload of game logic/code without recompiling, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the claimed compile times.
